201.description: Where the onboarding stands after the move.

appliedStep.description: The step whose transition the submit applied, normally the one that was current when the data arrived; null when no transition was applied.

status.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.

allOf.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.
allOf.title: WorkflowStatus

currentStep.description: The step now awaiting data; null once the onboarding is terminal.

rejectionReason.description: Why a connector refused, when the move was a rejection a connector drove; null otherwise.

allOf.description: Why a connector refused the step's data: the caller exhausted its attempts, the challenge expired or was never issued, or the provider rejected outright.
allOf.title: ConnectorRejectionReason

400.description: `INVALID_STEP_DATA`: The submitted data violates the current step; `errors` maps each refused field to its reasons (`UNKNOWN`, `REQUIRED`, `INVALID`, `CALLBACK_ONLY`, or a connector's own), and the onboarding stays where it was.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

404.description:
`ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND`: No onboarding has this id.

`WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND`: No published workflow has this id, or no revision of it carries the pinned version.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.

409.description:
`ONBOARDING_COMPLETED`: The onboarding is already approved or completed and accepts no further moves.

`ONBOARDING_AWAITING_CONNECTOR`: The onboarding is parked on an asynchronous connector and accepts no client submit until its callback, or an operator reconcile, decides the step; `pendingConnector` names the connector. Poll the state rather than resubmitting: a resubmit would open a second provider attempt.

`UNKNOWN_WORKFLOW_EVALUATION`: The workflow produced no outcome the engine can apply; the onboarding is left unchanged.

410.description: `WORKFLOW_RETIRED`: The pinned revision is retired and can no longer be read or run.

500.description:
A connector failed in a way its adapter raises as a plain error rather than one of the codes below: an `http_request` call that could not be sent or answered with an unexpected status, a Sumsub level or credential that does not resolve, or a Veriff credential or payload that does not resolve. The framework answers with its own envelope, so there is no `code` to branch on; the connector, the step and the reason are in the audit trail.

`TWILIO_VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE`: Twilio Verify could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`SENDGRID_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE`: SendGrid could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`SUMSUB_UNAVAILABLE`: Sumsub could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`VERIFF_UNAVAILABLE`: Veriff could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`CLIENT_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED`: The client webhook for this move could not be delivered; the outbox entry was returned to pending for the worker to retry.

oneOf.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
oneOf.title: NestHttpError

503.description:
`CONNECTOR_NOT_CONFIGURED`: A connector the step calls has a required setting with no value; carries `connectorId` and `key`.

`AGREEMENT_NOT_PUBLISHED`: The workflow declares an agreement family nobody has published a version of; `key` names it. An operator publishes one and the same request then succeeds.
